fr_html: M. ALTAMIRA se félicite de voir adopter de nouveau l'article 30 du projet Root—Phillimore, qui a ses préférences, étant une expression la plus claire possible de la justice obligatoire.
en_html: M. ALTAMIRA was very glad that Art. 30 of the Root—Phillimore plan had once more been adopted. This provision appealed to him as being the clearest possible way of expressing the adoption of a compulsory jurisdiction.
